title: Insert Value into BST

monster.name: Root Scribe
monster.title: Placer of Binary Runes
monster.defeatQuote: The new element slotted into its sorted BST position!

description: Given the sorted values of a BST, insert a new integer `val` into the BST such that the resulting inorder traversal remains strictly sorted.
starterCode:
def insertIntoBST(inorder: list[int], val: int) -> list[int]:
    pass
solutionCode:
def insertIntoBST(inorder: list[int], val: int) -> list[int]:
    import bisect
    res = list(inorder)
    bisect.insort(res, val)
    return res
hints: BST inorder traversal is strictly ascending, so insertion maintains sorted order.
